name: Firecracker
description_html:
A vibrant assortment of hot pink, orange and red roses, pincushions and exotic palm fronds — curated for the Elements Collection. 

Light it up! This bright, eye-catching, fire-inspired Bouq features roses and spray roses in burgundy, fuchsia and orange, with bursts of pink dianthus and orange mini carnations, and pincushion sparks. Green palm fronds frame this show stopping display. 

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: Sweet Escape
description_html:
A tropical pink ginger flower bouquet.

And tell me boy, now wouldn’t that be sweet? What’s even sweeter than that catchy tune: exotic blooms like pink ginger and red cordyline paired with masajeana leaves and more super lush greenery, plus dried okra pods that can be kept for future use. This Bouq is like a little slice of paradise just for you (or one of your favorite people). For us, this one’s love at first sight. Just being honest.

This Bouq includes dried okra pods. While these are not edible and won't bloom, they will make a beautiful addition to decor or future bouquets!

name: Oasis
description_html:
Live snake plant housed in a metallic gold pot.

Sssspice up your life with our sleek snake plant. Upright green and yellow leaves are known for promoting focus and helping boost your memory. And if you believe all that glitters is gold, then this brushed gold ceramic planter is for you — especially if you’re looking for a good roommate! This plant purifies the air, reduces allergens, and it’s low maintenance. 

Care Instructions: Water when soil is completely dry and place in an area with indirect sunlight. (Bonus tip: Be extra careful of over watering in winter.)

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.

name: Grateful
description_html:
What’s Included: Prayer plant in a 6" white Ecopot

Show some gratitude for this tropical plant. Known as maranta leuconeura, this calming plant gets its other name – prayer plant – from the fact that its dark green leaves with feather-like veins lie flat during the day and then rise up into (what looks like) praying hands at night. This inherent movement of daily prayer, much like the act of saying “thank you,” is believed to symbolize a gesture of gratitude. Slow to grow, this houseplant comes in a 6" white Ecopot and lends vibrancy to any space.

Ecopots are made from recycled plastic and are lightweight and break-proof. These specially designed pots prevent overwatering and allow roots to breathe.

LIGHT
Medium indirect sunlight
 
WATER
Water every 1-2 weeks when top 2 inches of soil is dry

Shipping Note: Guaranteed delivery by date selected at checkout, but could arrive up to 2 days sooner. Cannot ship to Alaska or Hawaii.
